d: A carefree heir finds his world shaken when love, family expectations and hidden truths test his choices, leading him on an emotional journey of responsibility, romance and self-discovery.
After serving 14 years in prison, a man is released on parole. As he tries to reconnect with his family, he vows revenge against those who wronged him.
A Parsi family in Lahore see their Muslim and Hindu friends violently divided as partition follows British withdrawal from India.
A gang member participates in racing tournaments and soon falls in love with the event manager.
A group of friends hides a bag full of money and jewels in a haunted bungalow to ditch the police. When they try to retrieve the bag, a ghost makes them play a survival game.
Three brothers brought together by chance navigate their love lives while jealousy from village elders brews.
A man tries to get even with a powerful businessman who cost him money.
Four strangers across different walks of life serendipitously meet at a haunted graveyard. However, luck turns to misery when an insidious force awakens.
A vigilante military network eliminates corrupt officials. As pressure mounts on the police to find out who is responsible for the killings, a special investigator is summoned to track them down.
When Satya raises his voice against Guru, the latter revolts and bashes the former to hell. Satya makes a comeback as a cop to take revenge on Guru and put an end to his crime in Kurnool city.
